crawl: Chrome live crawl, same-origin fetch, cache: no-store, sequential per URL, on 2026-10-29 Vietnam time (a scan for 29 Oct, one day after the 28 Oct crawl).
method: TTFB measured with performance.now() around a sequential fetch of each URL with a 15 s abort. Words counted on a body clone with script/style/noscript/template removed. Schema blocks counted as application/ld+json elements, @type walked through @graph. Internal links are unique same-origin paths per page. MISSING-ALT RULE (in force since 2 Oct 2026): only visible outside
score_rationale: Health 97 -> 97 (raw 96.9 -> 96.9; weights .25/.25/.20/.15/.15). One-day step from 28 Oct and the site is essentially unchanged: the same 121 pages (17 core + 98 articles + 6 projects), all 200, the same 249,426 words, the same 413 JSON-LD blocks and the same 1,306 images with alt. PERFORMANCE holds at 99: all 121 pages answer in under one second, site mean TTFB 318.2 ms (318.4 on 28 Oct), median 258 ms (257), ceiling 554 ms (677). CONTENT holds at 94: no new article since 28 Oct, 13 thin pages and the duplicate Melbourne body unchanged. CRAWLABILITY holds at 98: 121/121 return 200, 0 orphans, the same 3 articles linked only from the hub; total distinct internal links FALL 2,879 -> 2,782 (22.99 per page, about one link fewer on each of 97 pages - a template link, cause not isolated), which does not change the score. ON-PAGE holds at 93: /articles/3d-rendering-company-melbourne is still cross-canonical (self canonical 120/121). STRUCTURED DATA holds at 98 (FAQPage 98/98 articles, 413 blocks).
